title: Compatible affine algebra quotient reductions yield cartesian scheme maps
statement: Let X,Y,X_n,Y_n be schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let j_n : X_n -> X be closed immersions [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], f_n : Y_n -> X_n affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and g_n : Y_n -> Y_(n+1) such that g_n followed by (f_(n+1) followed by j_(n+1)) equals f_n followed by j_n. Let g : Y -> X be affine and B a commutative O_X-algebra sheaf [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf] with an algebra isomorphism B -> g_*O_Y. Suppose O_X-algebra morphisms b_n : B -> (f_n followed by j_n)_*O_Yn are given. On every affine open U require b_n(U) to be surjective with kernel the extension to B(U) of ker(j_n sharp on U). On every open U require b_(n+1)(U) followed by g_n sharp to equal b_n(U), with the preimage domains identified by the fixed composition equality. Then there exist u_n : Y_n -> Y such that the square (u_n,f_n,g,j_n) is cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product], and g_n followed by u_(n+1) equals u_n.

source.place: Lemma 09ZT, last sentence, recovery of Y_n; Morphisms 01S8/01SA, affine correspondence

proof.text: Compose alpha inverse with each b_n. Apply affine_algebra_local_maps, glue the compatible maps over inverse images of the affine basis, and cancel top-section isomorphisms to recover the prescribed section maps. This constructs u_n over X without selecting data from any unproved existence theorem. The generalized private helper unique_over_map_of_algebra also proves uniqueness among over-X morphisms with those section maps; its uniqueness clause is used directly in step 3.

On each affine U, the ring square formed by j.app, the algebra structure map, f.appLE and b.app is a pushout: descend any compatible pair via the surjective b.app; its kernel is the extended kernel of j.app, and surjectivity of j.app proves the other factorization. Transport this pushout by alpha and the top-section isomorphisms, apply Spec, and identify all four affine schemes via isoSpec. Paste with the restriction square for j and use Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover on the inverse images of the affine basis in Y. These are the proved private helpers quotient_pushout, affine_pullback_of_pushout and affine_algebra_quotient_isPullback.

For gn followed by u_(n+1), composition of appLE and hcompat give the prescribed section maps of alpha inverse followed by b_n. Apply the uniqueness clause of unique_over_map_of_algebra. That clause is proved by comparing resLE maps into affine inverse images under g using ext_of_isAffine and top-section transport, then Scheme.hom_ext_of_forall.

lean.statement: theorem affine_algebra_reductions_cartesian {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (Xn Yn : ℕ → Scheme.{u}) (j : ∀ n, Xn n ⟶ X) [∀ n, IsClosedImmersion (j n)] (fnY : ∀ n, Yn n ⟶ Xn n) [∀ n, IsAffineHom (fnY n)] (gn : ∀ n, Yn n ⟶ Yn (n + 1)) (hw : ∀ n, gn n ≫ (fnY (n + 1) ≫ j (n + 1)) = fnY n ≫ j n) (g : Y ⟶ X) [IsAffineHom g] (B : X.CommAlgebraSheaf) (α : B ≅ 𝒪⁎g) (b : ∀ n, B ⟶ 𝒪⁎(fnY n ≫ j n)) (hb : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen U → Function.Surjective ((b n).right.hom.app (op U)).hom ∧ RingHom.ker ((b n).right.hom.app (op U)).hom = (RingHom.ker ((j n).app U).hom).map (B.hom.hom.app (op U)).hom) (hcompat : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens), (b (n + 1)).right.hom.app (op U) ≫ (gn n).appLE ((fnY (n + 1) ≫ j (n + 1)) ⁻¹ᵁ U) ((fnY n ≫ j n) ⁻¹ᵁ U) (by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, hw n]) = (b n).right.hom.app (op U)) : ∃ u : ∀ n, Yn n ⟶ Y, (∀ n, IsPullback (u n) (fnY n) g (j n)) ∧ (∀ n, gn n ≫ u (n + 1) = u n)
